added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: follow-on: section 2 says the pf_active turns were "read back from the committed store machine_description/OP1/pf_active.nc" with per-coil turns_with_sign values, but coil_turns_source.py never opens that store -- its only converter evidence is selene_deck.py:793 in code -- so the sentence asserts an observation the node's own artefacts do not record; the conclusion holds (I verified deck and writer independently) but the evidence is claimed, not shown.

follow-on: the FPPC_UP/FPPC_DOWN rows give turns/filament 3.83 and total turns 22.98, but the deck's six FPPC filaments alternate 3.83/3.84 (EQSLE.DATA lines 280-291) and sum to 23.00, so the single-value column and the 22.98 total understate the block; the note reconciles to 23 in prose so no reader is misled, but the table itself is imprecise.

item_verdicts.diff: read the single commit 00f986100282 against a1980fe0a761; it adds one evidence fragment of 148 lines and nothing else, and I re-read the deck, the catalogue and the adapter it cites.
item_verdicts.done_when: this read-only node's measure is its fragment plus the recorded run of coil_turns_source.py; the manifest's tests field names that script at exit 0 and coil_turns.log records the deck values, the 268-connection topology and the three per-coil fits, so the measure is recorded rather than claimed.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to name each PF coil's per-filament turn count from the SELENE deck with its source lines, compare it with the 1.0-per-filament the drive topology writes and with a free per-coil fit of the vacuum response, and write one fragment and no source; docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-coil-turns-source.html lands exactly that.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits [00f9861002825a823a045f1ff27669838f11921b], changed_paths the one fragment, and it states the deck turns, the topology 1.0 and the not-identifiable fit; but its section-2 claim of a pf_active.nc read-back has no matching line in coil_turns.log.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares the fragment and a figures directory, and git show 00f986100282 touches only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-coil-turns-source.html (148 insertions) inside the declared set, with no source changed.

justifications.durability: an evidence node lands no code, so its durability is reproducibility; I re-derived the deck lines, imas_ambix/data/machine_maps/jt-60sa.json drive_topologies and geometry_adapter._materialise_circuit_drives, but the fragment's pf_active read-back is not reproducible from the run's own artefacts.
justifications.evidence: coil_turns.log reproduces the deck table, the 268-connection turns=1.0/current_weight=1.0 topology and the ampere_turns_per_ampere 40/16/6, but docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-coil-turns-source.html:62 asserts a pf_active.nc read-back the script never made.
justifications.fit: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-coil-turns-source.html follows the evidence-fragment idiom (doctype, docs-project/reckon-type/plan-slug meta, a single data-reckon="evidence" section) used by its sibling jtmm-vacuum-mismatch-rca.html.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-coil-turns-source.html names 13.725 turns/filament for CS1-CS4 (lines 24-183) and 8.875-22.0625 for EF1-EF6 (lines 184-279), which I confirmed against EQSLE.DATA lines 22-291 directly.
justifications.reuse: the fragment adds no code; it reuses build_operator, read_geometry_table, read_channel and the packaged catalogue rather than forking a capability, so nothing is duplicated.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show 00f986100282 --stat changes only docs/evidence/fragments/jt60sa-machine-map/jtmm-coil-turns-source.html inside the manifest's declared write paths and no source file.
